source.note: Knight.glb from the pack's GitHub mirror (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg). The rig carries every alternative prop; kept 1H_Sword + Badge_Shield, dropped 1H_Sword_Offhand, 2H_Sword and the Rectangle, Round and Spike shields. 27 of 76 clips kept (1H sword-and-shield set; ranged, 2H, dual-wield, spellcast, unarmed and lie-down clips dropped). Height 1.6 m: KayKit characters are chibi (head about a third of the body), so a 1.8 m adult scale makes the head read huge next to realistic props; 1.6 m keeps the helmet near a real head size.
